test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Choose the option that means the same as the underlined segment.**

His deep study of the case __**uncovered more problems**.__
solution:
The correct answer is "opened Pandora's box."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 

__
 
• The option, which means the same as the underlined segment **"uncovered more problems"** is **"opened Pandora's box."**
 
• This idiom means to reveal a situation that leads to a series of unforeseen and usually problematic consequences, which aligns with the idea of uncovering more problems during the deep study of a case. (ऐसी स्थिति को प्रकट करना जो अप्रत्याशित और आमतौर पर समस्याग्रस्त परिणामों की एक श्रृंखला की ओर ले जाती है)
 
 
• **Example**: *Her decision to investigate further **opened Pandora's box**__ of complications.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
